ios.desc:
SALAAM ® is the award-winning app that makes learning Arabic simple and fun! Quickly learn essential vocabulary, phrases, and grammar concepts.

Designed especially for students and tourists.

Vocabulary and Phrases
-------------
• Contains 50 lessons based on REAL LIFE situations including flight and hotel reservations, dining out, shopping, exploring and meeting new friends.
• Includes over 2000 VOCABULARY words and phrases for both beginner and advanced learners.
• Play while learning with Hangman and Concentration games.
• Learn to PRONOUNCE correctly with high-quality audio by NATIVE SPEAKERS.  
• Includes complete ARABIC ALPHABET course.

Quizzing Features
-------------
• Multiple-choice quiz ADAPTS to your skill level.
• Memorize words quickly with our DYNAMIC QUIZZING algorithm. 
• Track LESSON PROGRESS across devices with iCloud syncing.

Please note that premium lessons within the app are available with a subscription.

The options for a subscription are:
Monthly subscription for $US2.99 (or the equivalent in local currency), and
Annual subscription for $US9.99 (or the equivalent in local currency).

Subscriptions automatically renew, unless auto-renew is turned off in your iTunes App Store preference at least 24-hours before the beginning of the next payment cycle. Upon cancellation of your subscription, access to the premium lessons will terminate at the end of the current payment cycle.

------------
We're always happy to hear from you! Have a suggestion or problem?
Contact us at info@pangaealearning.com
